SELECT CASE WHEN prev_count = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND(((curr_count - prev_count) * 100.0 / prev_count), 2) END as growth_rate FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND DATE(created_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)) as curr_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND DATE(created_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} * 2 DAY) AND DATE(created_at) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)) as prev_count ) as counts
